description: Source file implementing type handling and mangling for a shader compiler, including class definitions for TType, TFieldListCollection, TPublicType, and related functions.

classes.name: TType
classes.description: Represents shader data types, including scalar, vector, matrix, struct, and interface block types, with methods for type properties, mangling, size calculation, and symbol creation.

classes.name: TFieldListCollection
classes.description: Manages collections of shader fields, providing size, nesting, and type containment analysis.

classes.name: TPublicType
classes.description: Holds public type information, including basic type, array sizes, qualifiers, and user-defined structures.

methods.name: getBasicString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a basic type enum.

methods.name: buildMangledName
methods.description: Generates a unique mangled name for the type based on its properties.

methods.name: getObjectSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the type object, considering arrays and structures.

methods.name: getDeepestStructNesting
methods.description: Returns the maximum nesting depth of nested structures.

methods.name: isStructureContainingArrays
methods.description: Checks if the structure contains arrays.

methods.name: isStructureContainingMatrices
methods.description: Checks if the structure contains matrices.

methods.name: containsType
methods.description: Checks if the structure contains a specific basic type.

methods.name: createSamplerSymbols
methods.description: Creates sampler variable symbols for shader resources.
